g.id: 2. Screen the failure modes of the RCC gravity dam
1. Collect inputs: dam design, terrain, floods, downstream assets
3. Define scenarios: sunny day, flood day, PMF without failure
4. Set breach parameters: base, lower and upper cases
6. Run the scenarios and the sensitivity cases
5. Build the HEC-RAS 2D model: reservoir, dam, wadi to the sea
7. Check: volume balance, peak flow, stability. Fix and rerun if a check fails
9. Estimate consequences: people at risk, loss of life, damage
8. Map depth, velocity, arrival time and hazard
10. Classify the dam, report, feed the emergency plan
